svg.title: Settings · Country and relocation wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / SETTINGS / COUNTRY
Presets, custom mode, and dated relocation.
Selecting a preset sets currency, locale, account types, and tax. Other is labeled custom.
2034 keeps New York tax. 2035 and later use Florida. No earlier year changes.
Dual residency is out of scope. One jurisdiction per year.
A custom mode is labeled on every result
A preset updates currency, locale, account types, and tax together. France maps to the nearest preset, or Other with
Relocation takes effect from its completion year. 2034 stays on New York tax; 2035 onward uses Florida.
Locale changes formatting only. Amounts and rates still come from the backend.
Other is always labeled as custom on results, so no one mistakes it for a supported jurisdiction.
